algorithm.path: SolveEqs::run/commit -> ModelConverter::registerUnconstrainedParameters -> ModelConverter::reconstruct -> RealValue exact algebraic operations
algorithm.model: Rational replay remains the fast path. Affine definitions with algebraic dependencies use exact linear extraction and RealValue operations. Typed values take precedence; reconstructed algebraics clear stale rational defaults.
algorithm.parameters: Only dependencies absent from the entire residual assertion DAG and not themselves eliminated are eligible for zero choices. Defaults apply only when neither model channel supplies a value. Missing constrained or unregistered dependencies still fail reconstruction.
algorithm.transaction: Free-parameter metadata is recorded before assertion replacement, preserving the caller converter/IR rollback contract on allocation failure.
algorithm.dispatch: The old blanket NRA/NIRA definition-elimination exclusion is removed. Base-scope and difference-logic policies remain. No public Solver API, LRA/LIA assignment policy, runtime oracle or new feature gate changes.
